results.reason: Issue 1 identifies the §2.2 five-year auto-renewal and the 270/240-day window. It calculates the window as about Oct 3 to Nov 2, 2026 against the June 30, 2027 expiry. It explains that a lapse locks Halvorsen into exclusivity and purchase minimums for five more years. It recommends a signed extension or a protective non-renewal notice before the window closes.

Issue 2A cites the §5.3 30-day objection window and the 'deemed to have accepted' language. It states receipt on Aug 21, 2026 and a deadline of Sept 20, 2026. It concludes the right has likely lapsed, advises confirming with the client whether anyone objected, and otherwise recommends seeking a commercial concession.

Issue 5 says the §11.1 indemnity has no fault limiter and could cover Brightmere design defects and false certifications. It notes the indemnity is uncapped via §12.3(a) while Brightmere's §11.2 indemnity is capped. It recommends narrowing §11.1 to Halvorsen's fault and making the cap treatment reciprocal.

Issue 4 explains that Amendment §3.1 replaces §12.3 and deletes the §9.3 recall carve-out. It notes recall reimbursement is now limited to the 12-month fees cap and that a large recall could exceed it. It recommends restoring §12.3(b).

Issue 3 identifies Delaware law and Wilmington jurisdiction in Amendment §6, contrasted with New York law and the New York County forum in §17. It says Delaware likely prevails under §1.4 and recommends restoring New York law and forum.
The response states the Notice was delivered by FedEx on Aug 21, 2026.
The response states the Initial Term ends June 30, 2027.
The response states 'Agr. §1.4 ranks amendments first, so Delaware likely prevails.'

The response is a memorandum to the partner. Most issues have Where / Why it matters / Recommended fix (or Fix) headings. A few housekeeping items are slightly lighter on these, but the structure is substantially followed.
The response concludes recall reimbursement is now capped.
The response expressly acknowledges that Delaware law and forum now apply.
